payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies the state-of-the-art tagging model used for extracting clinical concepts from provider-patient conversations as a Span-Attribute Tagging (SAT) model.

claims.text: The state-of-the-art tagging model used is a Span-Attribute Tagging (SAT) model.
The SAT model was trained using a corpus of about 6k clinical encounters labeled with an annotation scheme.
